title: trailboss --json checkpoint list AGENT:ID (and checkpoint save AGENT:ID)
description: A session's checkpoints, oldest first: its folder saved as git commits under refs/trailboss/checkpoints/<agent>/<session>/<n>. `save` returns one row; when nothing changed since the last checkpoint, that one comes back with `saved` false.

head.description: HEAD when the checkpoint was saved; null in a repository with no commits yet
